AND #&07                        \ the line in the cell
rows_imm = * + 1
    CMP #&00                        \ self-modified: rows
    BCC up
lo_imm = * + 1
    LDA #&00                        \ self-modified: lo. It stays in the cell (C = 1)
    SBC rows_imm
    RTS                             \ X is still hi
.up                                 \ d = rows - line - 1: 0 is the cell above's bottom line
    STX ra_hi
    EOR #&FF                        \ C = 0 from the BCC
    ADC rows_imm
    TAY
    EOR lo_imm                      \ lo AND &F8, OR the line it ends on: 7 - (d AND 7)
    AND #&07
    EOR #&07
    EOR lo_imm
    STA ra_lo
    TYA
    LSR A
    LSR A
    LSR A
    TAY                             \ cells up, less 1
    LDA ra_lo
    SEC
    SBC raise_cells_lo,Y
    STA ra_lo
    LDA ra_hi
    SBC raise_cells_hi,Y
    CMP #&40                        \ round the 16K screen
    BCS in_ring
    ADC #&40
.in_ring
    TAX
    LDA ra_lo
    RTS
candidates.new:
AND #&07                        \ the line in the cell
rows_imm = * + 1
    CMP #&00                        \ self-modified: rows
    BCS ra_stay_g3969               \ the line is in the cell: no crossing (the rarer path)
.up                                 \ d = rows - line - 1: 0 is the cell above's bottom line
    STX ra_hi                       \ hi parked: X is the index below
    EOR #&FF                        \ C = 0 from the BCS not taken
    ADC rows_imm
    TAY                             \ Y = d
    LSR A
    LSR A
    LSR A
    TAX                             \ X = cells up, less 1
    TYA
    EOR lo_imm                      \ lo AND &F8, OR the line it ends on: 7 - (d AND 7)
    AND #&07
    EOR #&07
    EOR lo_imm
    SEC
    SBC raise_cells_lo,X
    TAY                             \ Y = the low byte; C = no borrow
    LDA ra_hi
    SBC raise_cells_hi,X
    ORA #&40                        \ round the 16K screen: hi - up is above &2A, hi is &40-&7F
    TAX
    TYA
    RTS
.ra_stay_g3969
lo_imm = * + 1
    LDA #&00                        \ self-modified: lo. It stays in the cell (C = 1)
    SBC rows_imm
    RTS                             \ X is still hi
candidates.summary: Up path rebuilt: the common (row-crossing) case falls through BCS; hi parked in ra_hi once with X as the table index, d and then lo' kept in Y (no ra_lo store/reload, no second d copy), and the ring fix 'CMP #&40 / BCS / ADC #&40' (5-6 cycles) becomes ORA #&40 (2) since hi is always &40-&7F. 74 -> 62 cycles on the up path, +1 on the not-up path; 10 bytes smaller.
candidates.equivalence: Same function A,X,Y -> A=lo', X=hi' for every input. Not-up path (line >= rows): BCS (C=1 after CMP, taken) lands on the old fall-through code with C=1, so LDA #lo / SBC rows_imm / RTS are unchanged. Up path (line < rows, C=0 from the not-taken BCS, as the old BCC taken had): EOR #&FF / ADC rows_imm gives d = rows-line-1 exactly as before; the same d feeds the same merge (EOR lo, AND 7, EOR 7, EOR lo) and the same two table reads at index d>>3, with the same SEC and borrow chain. Only where values are parked changes: hi in ra_hi (as before), d in Y then lo' in Y, the index in X (raise_cells_lo,X / raise_cells_hi,X are the same bytes as ,Y). Exit: A=lo', X=hi' as before; Y now holds lo' (was the index on the up path and rows on the other, so no caller can rely on it; the one caller, ren_draw_sprite, reloads Y: compiled_part TAY, kc_part/draw_column.each LDY #). C on exit differed between paths already and is not read (the caller's next flag reads are AND #7 / LDA ds_clip / BIT / CMP). ra_lo is no longer written (only this routine names it; no other reader). Checked exhaustively in Python against the old code for lo 0-255, hi &40-&7F, rows 0-64: 0 differences; built and run in lockstep (passlock bench, 3000 passes seed 1, --screen): state and screen identical.
candidates.relies_on: hi (the screen address's high byte, raise_address's X) being in &40-&7F on entry: every producer keeps it there (add_delta_..._in_AX wraps with BMI/SBC #&3F, subtract_delta_... with CMP #&40/ADC #&40, screen_start_address_high, the respawn path use those), so hi - raise_cells_hi[n] - borrow is in &2A-&7F and 'x < &40 ? x + &40 : x' equals x OR &40. Page crossings: raise_address (&9D49-&9D8A, all in page &9D) is shorter by 10 bytes, so raise_cells_lo/hi (&9D8B/&9D93, reads at Y/X 0-7, same page after the slide to &9D81/&9D89) stay in page &9D and everything after (restore_block from &9D9B to &9D91 and on) slides down 10 bytes. Measured on the bench build (pcprof, work a pass: render 23430 -> 23407 seed 1, 28406 -> 28367 holding RIGHT), so the slide cost, if any, is already in those figures. BCS ra_stay is a forward branch of 38 bytes inside page &9D (taken 3 cycles, no page cross: &9D55-&9D7B). The BCC up -> BCS ra_stay swap: up path is the commoner (2.55 of 4.2 calls a pass from the window's measured cycles) so it now falls through: -1 on 2.55, +1 on 1.65. Nothing refers to raise_address.up (kept as a label) or raise_address.in_ring (dropped; tools/colfast.py names it in a category set only, a cosmetic report).
